findings.desc: type-safety: shared.ts:72 `return value as TokenDimension` is an unsound cast — the return type declares TokenDimension (number|null) but can be any malformed value (string, float, negative, NaN). This silences the TS type checker on an unsafe path and creates a contract lie that callers cannot detect statically. Prefer `return value as unknown as TokenDimension` (explicit double-cast) or introduce an internal RawTokenDimension type so the unsoundness is visible at every call site.

dead-code-duplication: `canonicalJson` and `sortValue` are copied verbatim in adapters/shared.ts (lines 31-46) and writer.ts (lines 72-89). The shared.ts comment says "Mirrors the writer's canonicalization" acknowledging the copy. These implementations can diverge silently — if the canonicalization algorithm is ever changed in writer.ts, shared.ts payloadDigest hashes could become inconsistent. Extracting both to a shared internal utility (e.g. packages/main/src/core/usage-ledger/canonical-json.ts) would remove the duplication without violating the pure/I/O boundary.
